description: Header file defining the LibcurlWrapper class, which provides an abstraction over libcurl for HTTP uploads, including method declarations and internal state variables.

classes.name: LibcurlWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for libcurl to facilitate HTTP uploads, mocking, and unit testing.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the libcurl wrapper, setting up necessary state.

methods.name: SetProxy
methods.description: Sets proxy configuration for HTTP requests.

methods.name: AddFile
methods.description: Adds a file to be uploaded via HTTP.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified parameters and captures response data.

methods.name: SetFunctionPointers
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for libcurl functions.
